name: Voice Demo
tagline: Push-to-talk realtime voice with Anna — live context injection, say(), barge-in.
description: Reference App for the realtime voice session surface (anna.audio.session): a push-to-talk microphone streams 16 kHz PCM to the host, which runs streaming ASR → this app's agent session → streaming TTS with barge-in. Demonstrates setContext() (per-turn live state injected into the prompt, never into history), say() (TTS-only text with priority/preemption), interrupt(), the gapless PCM player, and the usage summary returned on end().
